title: Emanate
summary: EM'ANATE, verb intransitive [Latin emanano; e and mano, to flow. 1. To issue from a source; to flow from; applied to fluids; as, light emanates from the sun; perspirable matter, from animal bodies. 2.

inlines.v: EM'ANATE, verb intransitive [Latin emanano; e and mano, to flow. 1. To issue from a source; to flow from; applied to fluids; as, light emanates from the sun; perspirable matter, from animal bodies. 2. To proceed from a source of fountain; as, the powers of government in republics emanate from the people.
